fieldValues.title: Work a ranked remedy depends on can sit parked where nobody sees it
fieldValues.statement: An issue stays parked when its own problem serves no ranked objective, even when an affirmed remedy on a ranked epic cannot land without it. Nothing links the two: the blocked work shows no blocker, and the parked issue shows no reason to move. srs-rust#1333 sat parked under SP-26 while it blocked remedy 751b6940 on epic #29; it was found only because the editor's own note named it.
